# Counting warnings
def count_warnings(log_stream, start_time, end_time):
    count = 0
    for log in log_stream:
        log_time = datetime.strptime(log[:19], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        if start_time <= log_time <= end_time:
            count += 1
    return count

# Determine first moment of time with at least m warnings in the last n seconds
def first_moment_of_time(log_stream, n, m):
    start_time = datetime.strptime(log_stream[0][:19], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    end_time = start_time + timedelta(seconds=n)
    current_count = count_warnings(log_stream, start_time, end_time)

        end_time += timedelta(seconds=n)
